The regularised Echinarachnius parma upper-test example already has artwork narrower than 170 mm despite its 180 mm source canvas. The canvas is cropped by 5 mm at each side and the unchanged-size artwork translated left by 5 mm; no anatomical curve is scaled or removed. The continuous disc and all five paired, open-ended petaloid surface bands remain, with no lunules or invented central holes. Individual pores, tiny periproct/genital anatomy and specimen plating remain intentionally omitted as in the source. Fresh Index dots are generated at the same physical sizes.
